text: Okay team, line up! Time to merge sort!
Split in half! Left team, right team!
Halves of halves! That's quarters! Split again!
Split again! Eighths! Everybody's on their own now!
Group of one? Already sorted! That's the stopping rule!
Now merge! Compare the two in front. Smaller one steps up!
Last merge! Two halves make a whole!
Nobody left to compare? Just walk right in!
SORTED! Every single one! That is championship hustle!
Split, split, split. Then merge, merge, merge. That's merge sort, and that's recursion!
You're computer scientists now! Give yourselves a big cheer!
